column3: Share links are served with cache-control private, no-cache instead of private, max-age=60
column4: XIN-23 review of #49 (medium): a browser that had opened a link kept showing it for up to a minute after Stop sharing. no-cache makes every view revalidate, and the ETag keeps a repeat view a 304 with no body, so a view still costs one Worker request and two R2 reads, as before
column5: plugins/drive/drive.test.ts: revalidate test asserts the header on 200 and 304 and a 404 after unshare with the old etag
